0.long_answer: Proteus syndrome is a rare overgrowth disorder characterized by the development of various benign and malignant tumors due to dysregulation in cell growth and differentiation. Among male patients, one of the concerns is the elevated risk for developing cancers in the reproductive system. Specifically, male patients with Proteus syndrome are at risk of developing prostate cancer, a malignant tumor of the prostate gland which is an integral part of the male reproductive system. This risk is identified by its inclusion in key entities related to reproductive system cancers in Proteus syndrome and hamartoma tumor syndromes.
